dedupe_keys.name: historical annual average daily traffic volume

description: Historical Annual Average Daily Traffic Volume is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Transport and Planning. Historical Annual Average Daily Traffic Volume datasets (2001 - 2019) provides annual average daily traffic (AADT) volume data for all vehicles and heavy vehicles in each direction on each road segment on the Victoria declared road network. The data is either estimated through data processes or actual volumes from data collection. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Transport and Planning . Its tags are aadt, heavy vehicle, heavy vehicle volume, traffic, traffic volume. It offers 19 resource(s) in GEOJSON. The portal shows 2025-07-16 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
